enrichment.summary: Configures a Conditional Access policy to require multi-factor authentication, a compliant device, or a domain-joined device for all users accessing any application on any platform, but the policy is currently disabled.
enrichment.rationale: This policy enhances security by ensuring that only authorised users with secure devices or additional authentication can access organisational resources, reducing the risk of unauthorised access.
enrichment.userImpact: No visible change for users as the policy is currently disabled.
